selection_receipt.rationale: Converge the living pixel field, bento spatial language, and evidence-ledger content logic without adopting any static mockup wholesale.
selection_receipt.identity_fit: Production-systems architect is the sole primary identity; creative practice remains visible through work and resume lenses.
selection_receipt.proof_hierarchy_fit: L1 leads with the expensive problem, two equal audience doors, and selected work; quantitative evidence is bounded by source, date, state, and limitations.
selection_receipt.accessibility_risk: Moving environmental color can reduce legibility unless every text region uses an opaque surface and motion is governed globally.
selection_receipt.performance_risk: Keep the existing 24fps canvas constants and replace the image-based laurels with semantic HTML and a lightweight CSS rail.
